Orinetimi eshte nga Lindja, pra apartamenti ka drite natyrale gjate gjithe kohes.
Apartamenti disponon dokumetacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Ndodhet ne nje zone e cila i ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme si psh: shkolla, kopshte, farmaci, klinika, lokale, restorante, linja urbani, spitale, universitete etj. Kjo e ben dhe nje prone perfekte per nje jetese komode por edhe per investim.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!

The apartment is organized in a living room, kitchen, 2 bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony which is large and spacious and connects all three rooms of the apartment. together. The orientation is from the East, so the apartment has natural light all the time. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation. It is located in an area that offers all the necessary facilities such as: schools, kindergartens, pharmacies, clinics, bars, restaurants, urban lines, hospitals, universities, etc. This makes it a perfect property for a comfortable life but also for investment. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
